first_success.name: Create one named test workspace and see its dashboard containing the starter task.

would_return_reason: Simulated mobile-persona judgment: the landing content is clipped and the primary start control is outside the narrow viewport, requiring horizontal scrolling before beginning.

issues.summary: Landing content overflows the 375px viewport and places the primary start control entirely offscreen.
issues.reproduction: Open http://127.0.0.1:4179/ in a fresh isolated browser context. Resize to 375×812 CSS pixels. At horizontal scroll position zero, inspect the landing page: the main content is 680px wide and Start a workspace is at x=474, y=424, width=177, height=51. No UI click is needed to reproduce.
issues.expected: Landing copy and the primary workspace-start control fit within the 375px viewport and are reachable without horizontal scrolling.
issues.actual: innerWidth=375 and innerHeight=812, but document.documentElement.scrollWidth=680. Main content spans x=0..680 and the primary start link spans x=474..651, wholly outside the viewport. Screenshot shows clipped heading and paragraphs and no primary start link. The Open workspace header link is visible, but the persona stops at the explicitly assigned horizontal-overflow condition before taking an alternate route.

limitations: Slow 3G: not tested. Inspected the actual MCP tools/list response; no network-throttling tool is exposed. No synthetic throttling or latency measurement was used.

Viewport resize only: no touch, mobile user agent, mobile hardware, or device-scale emulation claimed. Browser reported HeadlessChrome/155.0.0.0 on a desktop Mac user agent; exact MCP server package version was not exposed by the adapter.
